title: Add MIT LICENSE and broaden the README
description:
**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** Caducus is public with no licence file. Anthus's public repos such as Prospectus use MIT. Add `LICENSE` (copyright AnthusAI) on Ryan's yes, and open the README with the new direction: it decides what deserves your attention and gets it to you, with the radar as one part. Claims describe only what has shipped.

**Acceptance.**
`gh repo view --json licenseInfo` shows MIT.
